name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Luna goes with none of Pilot, Cortex, or Diatoms.
Plankton goes with at most two of Fontaine, Drift, and Luna.
Engineer, Cortex, and Plankton belong to different colonists.
Diatoms goes with exactly two of Anders, Aurora, and Ceres.
